guarantees.claim: scale_omega2_b is continuously assigned as aes_scale_omega2_gf2p2(aes_square_gf2p2(b1 ^ b0)).
scale_omega2_q is continuously assigned as aes_scale_omega2_gf2p2(aes_square_gf2p2(q1 ^ q0)).
mul_b1_b0 is continuously assigned as aes_mul_gf2p2(b1, b0).

assumptions.claim: Input pairs (b1, b0) and (q1, q0) are consistent masked representations where each pair XORs to an intermediate plaintext value, and they are driven from registered, glitch-free logic.
assumptions.risk: Incorrect sharing may break the masked inverse computation, exposing secret intermediate values through power or timing side channels.

uncertain_points.claim: The comment warns against aggressive synthesis optimizations that could merge these terms with later additions, risking glitch-based leakage or break of the masking scheme. It is unclear if synthesis constraints enforce this separation.
uncertain_points.risk: If synthesis merges the signals, the masked computation may produce correlated transitions that leak secret information.
